notes.title: 🎥 Check Out Nanuka’s Dev Diary Episode 6
notes.notes:
Nanuka’s Dev Diary Episode 6 is live!

[previewyoutube=VsophcV5T8w;full][/previewyoutube]

🚀 We’re thrilled to share exciting updates on Nanuka: Secret of the Shattering Moon! Our latest game is coming to life, and Episode 6 of the Dev Diary series offers a behind-the-scenes look at its development:

A massive 77-screen level in progress.
A new ally: The Blacksmith, introducing unique gameplay mechanics.
Swamp-level gameplay filled with quirky hazards.
Pixel art refinements and stunning particle effects.

🎬 Watch the episode now to see what’s new!

🛒 Wishlist Nanuka on Steam and support our journey:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1859580/Nanuka_Secret_of_the_Shattering_Moon

If you’ve enjoyed our other games like Wild Baffo, you’ll love Nanuka’s hand-drawn pixel art, quirky characters, and fun, action-packed gameplay. Follow our dev diary series and stay updated as we bring this vibrant 2D platformer to life!

🌟 Thank you for your support, and let us know what you think of Nanuka’s development journey!

#Nanuka #DevDiary #IndieGame #ActionPlatformer #PixelArt #GameDevelopment #OutOfTheBit
